name: Cron Persistence via Direct Write to Cron Directory
description: Detects a shell command whose command line references a system cron directory (/etc/cron.d, /etc/cron.daily, /etc/cron.hourly, /etc/cron.weekly, /var/spool/cron), a common Linux persistence mechanism when combined with a redirect or file write. Linux analog of the scheduled-task-persistence rule. Source: detections/rules/proc_creation_lnx_cron_persistence.yml, hand-converted from Sigma (no ecs_linux/auditd pysigma pipeline exists, so this EQL targets the real auditbeat auditd-module field shape directly).
query: any where process.executable like~ ("*/bash", "*/sh", "*/dash") and process.title like~ ("*/etc/cron.d/*", "*/etc/cron.daily/*", "*/etc/cron.hourly/*", "*/etc/cron.weekly/*", "*/var/spool/cron/*")
false_positives: Legitimate package installers (e.g. apt postinst scripts) writing cron.d entries during install
author: Sentinel
